name: weighted one hand pull up
description: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.
instructions: Hang from a bar with one hand and hold a light dumbbell in the other hand at your side.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder down.
Pull yourself up with the hanging arm until your chin reaches the bar.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.
